## Verification Checklist

Please ensure you have completed the following before requesting a review:

- [ ] `cargo fmt` has been run and passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` has been run and passes
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` has been run and passes
- [ ] Documentation (`README.md`, `docs/`) updated (if applicable)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated with a brief summary (if applicable)
- [ ] GitHub Actions CI passes successfully
